name: bop_extra
description: An extension dataset for the BOP (Benchmark for 6D Object Pose) benchmark that provides additional real and synthetic scenes for evaluating 6D object pose estimation methods. It is used to test object detection and precise pose recovery under occlusion, clutter, and varying lighting conditions. Evaluation relies on established BOP pose-error measures and dataset-specific protocols.
evaluation_method: average_recall (BOP pose estimation metrics such as VSD, ADD(-S))
typical_sota_score: varies by object and dataset; typically in the range of ~60–90% (dataset-dependent)
reputation: Widely used within the 6D object-pose community as part of the BOP benchmark suite.
